verdict.rationale: A state business-filing authority could plausibly document a sanctioned third-party rail such as registered agents or authorized filers, so the delegated-access axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes: both SCC hosts disallow all crawling, and Virginia Tax bans GPTBot by name. No page describing designees, registered agents, or authorized-provider access was fetched, so there is no evidence the capability is documented. Confidence is low because the absence reflects crawl walls rather than a confirmed gap.
